claim: Differential probe-recovery time (bistable arm / rigid arm) tested at one pre-committed compression checkpoint detects an approaching snap-through with at least 15% lead on the load range, at >=80% detection and <=10% false positive on a rigid creep-only null, robust to timing noise up to 10%.
name: ep2_prereg
reason: pre-committed checkpoint: detection >= 0.8 and null false positive <= 0.1 at >= 4/5 seeds in every swept timing noise
refute_if: detection_rate_checkpoint < 0.80 OR null_false_positive_checkpoint > 0.10 - either at >=3 of 5 seeds in any swept timing_noise
